summary: After a capped or --full dependent fan-out, SaveSyncStates remaining atomic: if the cursor/backlog/turn transaction fails to begin, execute, or commit, runDependentFanOut must return that error (and must not emit sync_complete or a cap-hit progress warning). A regen that writes the three continuation rows together but discards the error reintroduces a false-progress resume loop.
reason: The three continuation rows were already written in one transaction, but runDependentFanOut discarded the SaveSyncStates error and reported progress from the fetched-record count. A failed checkpoint left the next invocation repeating completed requests and writes while the command claimed success. Greptile P1 on mvanhorn/printing-press-library#1773.
validated_outcome: go test ./... from library/health/peloton; TestFullSyncCheckpointSaveErrorFailsTheCommand injects a SQLite trigger on the continuation keys so fan-out upserts succeed and only the checkpoint transaction fails.
